contributions.anchor: the p2 Summary Page line 1 'TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED' Column A 'Total this Period' — a SLASHED ZERO (0 under the zero-glyph ruling), the same glyph in Column B; corroborated by Schedule A's own printed banner 'NONE (NO CONTRIBUTIONS)' written across printed row 1
contributions.detail: ZERO contribution rows sum to 0.00 = the promoted per-period cell (Column A line 1, slashed zero) = Column B YTD (slashed zero). ⚠ DIVERGENCE, TRACED AND NOT RECONCILED: Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' AND 'Total Contributions Received' both print (65.00) in accounting parentheses = -65.00 (crop-proved at 900 dpi). That figure is the filer's memo of the ONE dated line he wrote on printed row 2 — '04-05-14 / (LOAN TO SELF) / [address blank] / 65.00' — whose amount cell is crop-proved UNPARENTHESIZED and positive. Per ADDENDUM A §A4 / B §B3 the ladder decides a loan line, never the word 'loan': this filer books the loan in the BALANCE SUMMARY, not as a contribution — his line 3 'Balance at Beginning' and line 4 'Total Contributions Received (From Line 1 Column A)' BOTH print (65.00) = -65.00, contradicting his own line 1 Column A slashed zero, and his line 1 plus the schedule banner are two independent affirmative statements that contributions this period were ZERO. The Witney-2010 branch, not the Kirk/Grierson branch. The loan line is therefore NOT an itemized contribution row and is preserved verbatim in `notes`; nothing was nudged and no figure was synthesized.

itemized.notes:
PAGE-FACE candidate 'JAMES O. TRACY', party 'REPUBLICAN', Office Seeking 'SHERIFF' — index.csv names NO candidate for this row (the 2008-2018 listing grouped by office), so the page face fills an empty channel label. 4 pages: p1 cover, p2 SUMMARY PAGE, p3 SCHEDULE A, p4 SCHEDULE B — each classified from its own printed header, and the filer's own foliation ('Page 2 of 4', '3 of 4', '4 of 4', cover excluded from the count but included in the denominator) agrees. Report type: the 'Seven days preceding the Primary Election' box is checked with a hand-drawn X; every other box is empty. The amendment question is WHOLLY UNANSWERED — neither Yes nor No is ticked — an honest BLANK, never 'No' (§A4). Cover signature date 06-17-14; the Date-of-Report box on p2/p3/p4 also reads 06-17-14 (no intra-document date discrepancy here). Clerk's 'JUN 17 PM 5:35' received stamp is present.

MIXED-TEMPLATE FILING, and it is a fresh confirmation of §F6 (the cover blank and the schedule blanks were stocked INDEPENDENTLY) and of §E2 (Tracy is a named mixed-template specimen): the p1 COVER is the common 2014 blank titled '2014 FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY & LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD CANDIDATES (Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5)', while pp2-4 are the COUNTY-ONLY inner sheets headed '2014 County Candidate' whose address column reads 'Mailing Address & Zip Code' and whose SCHEDULE B reuses 'Name of Contributor' over the vendor column. Neither sheet predicts the other; both were read on the page.

THE CONTRIBUTION SIDE — what the page actually prints, in full. Printed row 1 of Schedule A carries the BANNER 'NONE (NO CONTRIBUTIONS)' written across the Name column with an empty date cell and a crop-proved empty amount cell. This is a live instance of the §E3 fourth row-index trap: the banner publishes NO row but CONSUMES printed row 1, so the filer's single written entry sits on printed row 2 and no arithmetic gate could have revealed the shift. Printed row 2 reads, verbatim: date '04-05-14', Name of Contributor '(LOAN TO SELF)', Mailing Address & Zip Code left empty by the filer, Amount '65.00' (raised cents, crop-proved unparenthesised). Schedule A's own 'Subtotal for this page' and 'Total Contributions Received' both print '(65.00)' in accounting parentheses = -65.00. The filer's cover states contributions of ZERO twice (line 1 Column A and Column B are both slashed zeros) and books the loan in the balance ladder instead, where lines 3, 4, 5 and 6 ALL print (65.00). Per §A4/§B3 the ladder classifies a loan line, never its wording, and this is the Witney-2010 branch: the loan is NOT an itemized contribution and is invisible in the itemized contribution layer BY DESIGN, preserved verbatim here. The side is therefore `empty-schedule` — the page exists, the filer's own banner declares no contributions, and zero rows are published.

FILER ARITHMETIC RETAINED VERBATIM, NOT ADJUDICATED: the p2 ladder does not close under any single consistent reading. Line 5 is defined 'Add lines 3 and 4' but -65.00 + -65.00 = -130.00 against a printed -65.00; line 4 is defined 'From Line 1 Column A' but prints -65.00 where line 1 Column A is a slashed zero; line 6 is defined 'From Line 2 Column A' but prints -65.00 where line 2 Column A is +65.00. Only line 7 follows its own formula (5 - 6 = -65.00 - -65.00 = 0, printed as a slashed zero). Nothing was recomputed, nudged or repaired. Note also that a reading in which the loan WERE a contribution makes every magnitude on the document 65.00 and closes line 7 — that reading was tested and rejected because it requires overriding the filer's two affirmative zero statements at line 1 and his own schedule banner, which is inference, not reading.

REDACTION: the county blacked out the cover's Street Address / City / State / Zip row and the Area Code & Phone Number box (4 solid bars on p1). residence_city is therefore not recoverable from this filing. The Fax box is hand-written 'NONE'. Schedule A and Schedule B carry ZERO redaction bars, so every blank address cell on pp3-4 is the FILER leaving it empty, not the county covering it (§D2, verified). No street address or phone number is carried into this record in any field or note.
